checkpoint_note: All object reads taken 2026-10-25/26 against Sui mainnet GraphQL; object versions recorded below.

version_gate.effect: only v15 passes on the live object (version=4); v1-v9 abort 8 (expect 1), v10-v13 abort 8 (expect 2), v14 abort 8 (expect 3)

gating_observations.verify_not_paused: PauseState is a dynamic field on LendingProtocol.id; absent => not paused (allows borrow/withdraw/liquidate)
gating_observations.verify_borrow_limit: assert(borrowed_amount+amount <= borrow_limit) abort 30 -> all non-flash, non-partner borrows blocked

unprivileged_public_fns_without_verify_v.note: update_price (v1-v10) copies a genuine external-oracle PriceInfo into the internal oracle keyed by the PriceInfo's own coin_type (update_price_internal matches coin_type; only writes if external.last_updated > internal.last_updated). PriceInfo is a private-field struct of 378b2a10::oracle, constructible only by that module (get_price_info copy / update_price_from_pyth). => no arbitrary price injection.

oracle_misconfiguration.mechanism: 378b2a10::oracle::get_price_info: if a coin is not in price_infos, it falls back to AlternatePriceIdentifier[coin] and returns that coin's PriceInfo with coin_type rewritten to the requested coin.
oracle_misconfiguration.effect: AlphaLend's internal oracle values ALPHA ~355x too high; ALPHA-backed loans were massively undercollateralised => the reported Sept-2026 bad debt (Sui Foundation covered).
oracle_misconfiguration.current_mitigation: ALPHA market safe_collateral_ratio=0 (no borrow power), liquidation_threshold=99, deposit_limit=0, borrow_limit=0

incident.summary: AlphaFi winding down AlphaLend after a misconfigured ALPHA price oracle produced undercollateralised loans / bad debt; Sui Foundation covered the shortfall; maintenance mode (withdrawals open, no new deposits/loans); auto-liquidation of unpaid loans after 5 Nov 2026.

leverage_core.v19_v20_v21_module_diff: bytecode-identical for every module (no diff); only linkage/dependency pins differ

access_management.access_request_pattern: Core admin fns mutate state then return a non-droppable ActionRequest hot potato; caller must consume it via access::approve_request / approve_and_return_context (requires an allowlisted Entity and a rule that permits the action) or admin_approve_request (requires PackageAdmin). Atomic tx => failed approval reverts the mutation.
access_management.actionrequest_abilities: none (no copy/drop/store) => must be consumed; fields are module-private => cannot be destructured externally
access_management.package_admin_source: claim_package<OTW> requires a one-time witness from a module named access_init (only kai_leverage::access_init); OTW consumed at init

oracle.mechanism: Prices ingested from Pyth Pro PriceInfoObject via add_pyth_pro (public) into a caller-built PriceCollection; validate (public(package)) filters to config.price_object_allowlist (coin_type -> price object ID) and enforces max_age_secs / future-skew. Caller cannot inject prices for non-allowlisted objects.
oracle.smoothed_price: get_smoothed_price uses Pyth EMA; aborts if rail has none

finding_1.title: Rate Limiter Counts Principal Only (TVL guardrail bypass)
finding_1.verified_in_code: kai/leverage/core/sources/clmm/position_core.move create_position_ticket: limiter.consume_inflow(x_value+y_value) uses only principal_x/principal_y, not the borrowed amount
finding_1.impact: guardrail weakening only (allows faster TVL growth than intended); no direct value extraction; bounded by supply-pool utilization caps. Active configs set max_position_l/max_global_l = u128::MAX so the rate limiter is the main cap.

finding_2.title: SAV Vault first-depositor inflation
finding_2.note: current source has an edge case (vault.move ~580-598) that mints pre-existing balance to performance fees when lp supply==0, mitigating the classic ERC4626 inflation; not re-verified on-chain.

queries.version_chain: query($a:SuiAddress!){ package(address:$a){ address version linkage{originalId upgradedId version} packageVersionsBefore(last:30){nodes{address version}} } }
queries.version_specific_modules: query($a:SuiAddress!){ object(address:$a){ asMovePackage{ address version modules(first:50){nodes{name disassembly}} } } }  // pass any version's package address
queries.markets_dynamic_fields: query($k:[NameKey!]!){ multiGetDynamicFields(keys:$k){ name{type{repr} json} value{... on MoveValue{type{repr} json}} } }  // parent=markets table, name=u64 bcs
queries.oracle_priceinfo: query($k:[NameKey!]!){ multiGetDynamicFields(keys:$k){ ... } }  // parent=price_infos table, name type 0x1::type_name::TypeName, bcs=uleb128(len)||ascii
queries.objects_by_type: { objects(first:20, filter:{type:"<pkg>::<mod>::<Struct>"}){ nodes{ address version asMoveObject{ contents{ type{repr} json } } } } }
queries.events: { events(last:50, filter:{type:"<pkg>::<mod>::<Event>"}){ nodes{ timestamp sender{address} contents{json} } } }

method: Read-only Sui GraphQL. Enumerated every published package version (packageVersionsBefore + object(address) per version address to read that version's bytecode). Diffed per-version module disassembly to find version-gate constants and code deltas. Enumerated live shared objects (LendingProtocol, 36 markets via Table dynamic fields, 11 Kai SupplyPools, 20 PositionConfigs, Policy objects). Priced with DefiLlama coins API. Cross-checked the wind-down incident with public reporting. No signing, no deployment, no secret material written.
blockers: Nested UID objects (LendingProtocol.oracle id 0xd4c456a0..., Table ids) are not resolvable via GraphQL object(address)/multiGetObjects, so the AlphaLend internal-oracle PriceInfo values could not be read directly; ALPHA's live internal price was inferred from the external oracle's AlternatePriceIdentifier fallback + DefiLlama.
No sui CLI / JSON-RPC available (deprecated); simulateTransaction not attempted for reads.
Kai SAV vault (finding #2 target) is out of the assigned package scope and was not re-verified on-chain.
